answer: Pay only from outside demand: rewards come solely from fees that buyers pay for tasks, and each task is routed to a random key. Extra fake keys add no income, they only split the same flow. Self-dealing loses: a farm holding 10% of keys that buys 10,000 tasks at $0.10 spends $1,000, sees 90% go to honest keys, and recovers 1,000 x $0.10 x 0.8 = $80 after a 20% burn, a $920 loss. Fees are the only inlet, so no idle key finds an oasis of free pay, and a pigment tag on each paid task traces where it came from. In quiet hours unfilled fees roll over, so no new money is minted.
